entries.msgstr:
These are special boxes containing unique and valuable in-game items.
You can obtain boxes in the in-game Store or Premium Shop.
Tame the Dragon, Ride the Wind
TAME THE DRAGON, RIDE THE WIND
If you already own all vehicles from the list of possible box contents, then all subsequent vehicles you receive from Dragon Boat Boxes will be compensated in gold equal to their full value.

Every %(guaranteed0)s Dragon Boat Boxes are guaranteed to contain a Tier VIII–IX vehicle. If you open them without one dropping such a vehicle, then a Tier VIII–IX vehicle you do not already own will drop when you open the %(guaranteed0)s&zwnbsp;th Dragon Boat Box. When it does, the counter is reset.

You do not have any boxes.
You can get them in the in-game Store.
